title: Pub 61
venue_description:
Pub 61 - West Ashley Blues Jam Venue

Pub 61 located at 2366 Ashley River Road in West Ashley is an important venue for the Charleston blues community. The pub serves as the home for Lowcountry Blues Connection jam sessions hosting blues musicians and fans on select Sundays throughout the year.

Sunday Jam Sessions

Pub 61 hosts Lowcountry Blues Connection jam sessions on the 1st 3rd and 4th Sundays of each month from 5-9pm. These sessions are central to Charleston's blues culture providing a regular gathering place for blues musicians to collaborate and practice. The jam format allows for spontaneous musical interaction and creative exploration.

Lowcountry Blues Community

The venue functions as a hub for Lowcountry Blues Connection - an organization dedicated to keeping blues alive in the Charleston area. Member musicians perform regularly at various venues around town but the Sunday jams at Pub 61 serve as the primary gathering point. The organization maintains an active email list shares band performance schedules and organizes community events.

All Skill Levels Welcome

The Sunday jams welcome musicians of all skill levels from seasoned professionals to developing players. Sit-in opportunities are available and audiences are encouraged to participate or observe. This inclusive approach has built a strong community of blues enthusiasts in West Ashley.

Authentic Blues Focus

While various musical styles flow through the sessions the primary focus is blues. The accomplished host musicians can navigate traditional 12-bar blues standards contemporary blues compositions and related styles. The music ranges from traditional acoustic blues to electric blues depending on the assembled musicians.

Community Space

Pub 61 operates as a true neighborhood pub - casual unpretentious and focused on community. The free admission with tip-based support model keeps the emphasis on the music and musicians rather than commercial concerns. Regular patrons describe it as an authentic local gathering place.
